response.sql:
WITH trans_with_region AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trans_id,
    t.amount,
    t.type,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE CAST(t.date AS TEXT) >= '1996-05-09' AND CAST(t.date AS TEXT) <= '1998-01-06'
),
region_signed_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
      WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
    END) as avg_signed_amount
  FROM trans_with_region
  WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
  GROUP BY region
),
region_transaction_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM trans_with_region
  GROUP BY region
),
overall_avg_signed AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) as overall_avg
  FROM region_signed_stats
)
SELECT 
  rss.region,
  rss.avg_signed_amount,
  rtc.transaction_count,
  rss.avg_signed_amount / (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_signed) as ratio
FROM region_signed_stats rss
JOIN region_transaction_counts rtc ON rss.region = rtc.region
WHERE (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_signed) IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: trans.date is stored in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) so text comparison with '1996-05-09' and '1998-01-06' produces the intended date range. The schema shows DATE type; documentation specifies YYMMDD for other date fields but not trans.date.
The overall average used for the ratio is the mean of the per-region averages (only including regions with signed transactions), not the global average across all signed transactions.

alternatives.interpretation: If trans.date is stored in YYMMDD format (matching account.date and card.issued), convert the date bounds to YYMMDD strings for text comparison.
